title: fix: the commit check accepts the retest type
headline: The commit check accepts a `retest:` subject, the type for a test changed after its red commit, so a branch that uses it passes the name check; from 1.51.0 a push that carries one is held for the owner's yes.
alignment: v1.50.2 is a patch before build 24: one commit type added to both copies of the name check, never a PR title or a branch type, its test seen failing first.

items.text: The commit check accepts the `retest:` type, a test changed after its red commit, in the kit and the project copy of the name check; a PR title is never a retest subject. The hold for the owner's yes arrives with 1.51.0.
items.where: A commit whose subject starts with retest:
items.after: Accepted as a commit; a PR title still refused
items.test: tests/kit-hooks.test.mjs::the commit check accepts the retest type in both copies of the name check

verification: The name check test passes, with rows for the scoped form, a prefix match and the type fault message.
Break check: before d8ce185 the title row fails, since a retest PR title passed the name check.

decisions.decision: Retest is a commit type only
decisions.why: Never a branch type or a PR title, so the branch types stay as they are.
One commit type added; nothing else changes.

upgrading: Run install user, then install project: the name check changes.
limits: The rule text does not list retest yet; it changes with 1.51.0, which runs the score gate. A feat or fix commit that edits locked tests is not held on main until 1.51.0 brings the edit fence and the pre-push hold. A PR cut before this merges sees the old check until it takes in main.
